protocol.interpretation: diagnostic throughput for warm repeated calls; not single-call latency, no universal statistical significance claim
protocol.order: fresh serial processes, alternate AVX-enabled and disabled by trial
protocol.parity: every output bitwise against scalar reference before timing
protocol.policy: inspect all shapes; if dispatch overhead harms small shapes, preserve the original candidate and use a simple size boundary justified by this grid, then repeat the complete-model gate
